scope: TI THS3491RGT parallel load-sharing core adapted to the Logic RF Driver with inductor-first input and output filters; not an exact reproduction of the entire TIDA-060002 board

conditions.simulator: ngspice 45.2 shared library, PSpice compatibility, native XSPICE models
conditions.filter_type: Inductor-first fifth-order Butterworth on input and output, separately scaled for each test frequency

limitations: TI has demonstrated the load-sharing topology; these results are simulations of its adaptation to a different source, filter network, and load.
Identical nominal RGT macro-models do not establish actual AC phase/gain/current matching; offset sensitivity is one explicit stress, not a complete process corner.
Supply-current sign correction is explicit; nominal 25 C model is not an electrothermal or extracted-PCB model.
TI maximum linear output envelope applies to each chip; more output current does not double the permitted voltage swing.
The RGT model joins FB to OUT through 1 microohm and is not a complete package-parasitic extraction.
Filter and source limitations from the single-chip study apply; no capacitor-first filters are used in this study.
